name: coupled-triple-cell
title: Coupled cell: all three sub-cellular formalisms and all three coupling modes in one cell

behavior_tests.name: triple-chain-oscillates
behavior_tests.description: With all three formalisms coupled (particle→metabolism→fate), the fate 'divide' activity (emitted as probe_a) crosses the 0.5 cutoff at least twice — the full particle→metabolism→fate→reset chain cycles rather than latching.

limitations: Combines the oscillator and catalysis motifs; it inherits both their calibration caveats (empirical particle rate, MaBoSS mean-field lag).
Only the co-running of all three formalisms is a committed test; the triple-coupled rhythm's quantitative shape is shown in the viz but not pinned to a band.
claim: A single cell can run all three sub-cellular formalisms at once — a Smoldyn particle sim, an SBML-ODE metabolism and a MaBoSS fate network — coupled by all three modes simultaneously: the particle count catalyses the metabolism (B), the metabolite pins the fate input (A), and the fate output resets the metabolism (C).
experiment: Run coupled_triple_cell (a small vertex tissue of three-formalism CoupledCells) for 36 steps. Record one cell's particle C, metabolite C, fate 'divide' and the live ODE rate constant each step.
outcomes: The time series (viz/coupled-triple-cell.html) shows the full chain: the confined particle population holds a C level that sets the ODE rate; the ODE metabolite builds to threshold, pins the fate input, fires 'divide', which resets the metabolism — a clean period-3 rhythm driven by all three engines together. Computed live from real Smoldyn + tellurium + MaBoSS.

question: Can one cell run all three sub-cellular formalisms at once, coupled by all three modes (particle->metabolism->fate->reset)?

study_card.goal: Show that all three sub-cellular formalisms and all three coupling modes run together in one cell.
study_card.mechanism: One cell running a Smoldyn particle sim, an SBML-ODE metabolism and a MaBoSS fate network, coupled by all three modes: particles catalyse the metabolism (B), the metabolite pins the fate input (A), the fate output resets the metabolism (C).
study_card.why_before_next: This is the full CoupledCell exercised end to end — if the three formalisms co-run and the chain cycles, the adapter composes arbitrarily, which the tissue crown then scales.
study_card.expected_result: The full chain cycles (fate 'divide' crosses the cutoff >=2x), so all three formalisms run and are coupled by all three modes in one cell.
study_card.main_expert_question: With three solvers interleaved per step, is the fixed step order (particle, ODE, Boolean) a faithful operator-splitting, or does a stiff coupling need sub-stepping?
